svg.text: EBAZ4205 DDR control / clock routes: RAS CAS WE CKE ODT CS RESET CK
red=Top copper, blue=Bottom copper, yellow=DDR3 U66 pads, green=Zynq U31 pads, gray=series/passive pads, black rings=vias
PS-* and DDR-* segments are both included where the reference splits a signal through resistors.
Labels are endpoint net names; copper color still follows layer.
